{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Tumor imaging only at screening, no on-treatment assessments",
      "quote": "Tumor imaging (including brain imaging) | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "Tumor imaging is only listed at screening, with no on-treatment or end-of-treatment imaging. This is insufficient for an oncology efficacy trial, as response assessment is typically required at regular intervals.",
      "fix": "Add tumor imaging at specified intervals (e.g., every 6-8 weeks) and at end of treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "Coagulation tests only at screening and EOT, not during treatment",
      "quote": "Coagulation: PT, INR, and aPTT | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Coagulation is only measured at screening and end of treatment, but not during the treatment cycles. This may miss important safety signals, especially if the drug affects coagulation.",
      "fix": "Add coagulation assessments at least once per cycle or as clinically indicated."
    },
    {
      "title": "Urinalysis only at screening, Cycle 1, and EOT",
      "quote": "Urinalysis | X | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Urinalysis is not performed during most treatment cycles, which may miss renal toxicity or other urinary abnormalities.",
      "fix": "Include urinalysis at regular intervals (e.g., every cycle) or as clinically indicated."
    },
    {
      "title": "12-Lead ECG not performed at every cycle",
      "quote": "12-Lead ECG | X | X |  |  |  | X |  | X | X | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "ECG is performed only at screening, Cycle 1, Cycle 5, and then from Cycle 7 onward. This is inconsistent and may miss cardiac safety events in early cycles.",
      "fix": "Perform ECG at least every cycle or at specified intervals to ensure adequate cardiac monitoring."
    },
    {
      "title": "Screening window of 28 days may be too long for lab values",
      "quote": "Screening Days -28 to -1 (Day -28)",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "A 28-day screening window is long, and some lab values (e.g., hematology, chemistry) may change significantly during that time, requiring repeat tests.",
      "fix": "Consider shortening the screening window for lab assessments or require repeat labs closer to Day 1."
    },
    {
      "title": "Adverse events collected at screening, but baseline AE not defined",
      "quote": "Adverse events | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Adverse events are collected at screening, but typically AEs are only collected after informed consent and baseline. This may lead to capturing pre-existing conditions as AEs.",
      "fix": "Clarify that only AEs occurring after the first dose are recorded, or define baseline AE collection."
    },
    {
      "title": "Pregnancy test frequency may be excessive for postmenopausal women",
      "quote": "Serum or urine pregnancy test | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Pregnancy tests are required at every visit, including for postmenopausal women, which may be unnecessary and burdensome.",
      "fix": "Limit pregnancy tests to women of childbearing potential only, and reduce frequency to monthly or as per protocol."
    },
    {
      "title": "Physical exam and vital signs at every visit may be burdensome for long-term cycles",
      "quote": "Physical examination | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X | X |",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "For cycles 18 and beyond (Day 358+), requiring physical exam and vital signs at every cycle may be burdensome for patients on long-term treatment.",
      "fix": "Consider reducing frequency of physical exams and vital signs to every other cycle or as clinically indicated for long-term cycles."
    }
  ]
}
